The '''Eternal Fleet warship'''<ref name="Chapter 15">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=15}}</ref> was the main ship of the [[Eternal Fleet]], a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Warship/Legends|ships]] controlled by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[GEMINI]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] units.

==Characteristics==
The Eternal Fleet was entirely composed of hundreds of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] of this class, which operated in precise patterns and were able to execute devastating combined attacks. Destroy one of the vessels in the pattern as it was charging, and every vessel would explode, in the process destroying anything caught in the blast radius.<ref name="Chapter 1" />

[[File:Eternal_Fleet_warship_explodes.jpg|thumb|250px|left|An Eternal Fleet warship disintegrates from a self-destruct sequence.]]
The warships, approximately the length of a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstittued Sith Empire]] [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyer]], were highly advanced [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that were operated by sentient droids. They were faster than any other starship in the cosmos and were equipped with [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking]] technology.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=12}}</ref> The only vessels capable of outrunning them were those retrofitted to use [[Isotope-5]]. Neither the ships of the Empire nor those of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] were able to compete with them in battle.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=4}}</ref>

The ships could deploy [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and were equipped with drop ships that could operate in both [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and in an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. [[Skytrooper]] [[Boarding pod/Legends|boarding pods]] were used to penetrate an enemy vessel's [[Hull/Legends|hull]], permitting the Skytroopers to inflict damage throughout the interior of targeted ship.<ref name="Chapter 1" />
